### The Apostle of Hope
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/apostle-of-hope
Passage: 1 Peter 1:3
Points:
- Church history has often called Peter the Apostle of Hope due to his focus on God's saving mercy.
- Unlike modern definitions that suggest uncertainty, biblical hope represents confident assurance in God's unbreakable promises.
- The hope given to Christians is living and active, founded directly upon Jesus Christ’s resurrection from the dead.
- This living hope generates and sustains faith in the believer's daily life, pointing forward to eternal glory.

### How to See Hope and Value in Your Suffering
Author: C. Adam Clagg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/how-to-see-hope-and-value-in-your-suffering-bible-study-minute-april-17-2018.html
Passage: 1 Peter 1:6-7
Points:
- Peter understood hardship through personal failure and adversity, learning that trials are temporary and not divine rejection.
- Affliction serves a refining purpose, stripping away impurities to prove the authenticity of our faith.
- Suffering often prompts deeper prayer and strengthens intimacy with God amid difficult circumstances.
- Believers are never alone in hardship, and following Christ through pain points toward ultimate resurrection and relief.
